# 933. Number of Recent Calls

## Solution 1

```python
class RecentCounter(object):

    def __init__(self):
        self.q = collections.deque([])

    def ping(self, t):
        """
        :type t: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        while self.q and self.q[0] < t - 3000:
            self.q.popleft()
        self.q.append(t)
        return len(self.q)

# Your RecentCounter object will be instantiated and called as such:
# obj = RecentCounter()
# param_1 = obj.ping(t)
```
